package handler

import (
	robotdomain "GENRE_MODULE/game/idlesim"
	"GENRE_MODULE/game/robotaccess"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestIdleSimRobotBusiness(t *testing.T) {
	f := newIdleFixture(t)
	auth := gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, ticket string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		switch ticket {
		case "owner":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: f.player.ID(), SessionID: "owner", ServerID: 1}, nil
		case "outsider":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: 999999, SessionID: "outsider", ServerID: 1}, nil
		default:
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
	})
	cfg := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	cfg.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(cfg, robotaccess.Dispatch(f.engine), auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	run := func(ticket string, steps []bots.Step) {
		t.Helper()
		r := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(ticket), nil }, steps)
		if err := r.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s := r.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("robot: %+v", s)
		}
	}
	command := f.command(t, "queue", 0, 0, 0, 0)
	first := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: uint64(command.Seq), Kind: string(command.Kind), Station: int32(command.Station), Recipe: int32(command.Recipe), JobID: uint64(command.JobID), Count: int64(command.Count)}
	second := first
	second.Seq++
	second.Station = 1
	second.Recipe = 1
	invalid := second
	invalid.Seq++
	invalid.Kind = "not-a-command"
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: first}, {Request: first}, {Request: first, Reconnect: true}, {Request: second}, {Request: second}, {Request: invalid, WantCode: 1}})
	state := robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.player, f.player.Dao().GetState, robotdomain.Decode)
	if len(state.Receipts) != 2 || len(state.Stations[0].Queue) != 1 || len(state.Stations[1].Queue) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong committed business state: %+v", state)
	}
	before := robotRead(t, f.engine, f.player, func() string { return f.player.Dao().GetState() })
	run("outsider", []bots.Step{{Request: first, WantCode: 1}})
	if robotRead(t, f.engine, f.player, func() string { return f.player.Dao().GetState() }) != before {
		t.Fatal("unauthorized command changed authoritative state")
	}

	f.clock.Add(20000)
	collect := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: 3, Kind: "collect", Station: 0}
	collectOther := collect
	collectOther.Seq = 4
	collectOther.Station = 1
	order := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: 5, Kind: "order"}
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: collect}, {Request: collectOther}, {Request: order}, {Request: order, Reconnect: true}})
	if s := robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.player, f.player.Dao().GetState, robotdomain.Decode); s.Orders != 1 || s.Inventory != [3]int64{} || len(s.Stations[0].Queue) != 0 || len(s.Stations[1].Queue) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("production/collection/order cycle not settled once")
	}

}
